mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.3 percentage points signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening housing demand and negative sentiment toward cyclical equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below zero signals deteriorating manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in CPI above 0.5 percentage points signals falling inflation and reduced pressure on real interest rates, which supports higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that raises wage growth and input costs, which compresses margins and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 0.5% signals weakening consumer purchasing power, which reduces demand for goods and services and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05).
